dataset: Universities in mainland China whose bachelor's degrees a university elsewhere awards (Sino-foreign universities), read by first-degree tier as the awarding university
notes: Each one's graduates receive the awarding university's degree (most also receive the Chinese university's own). Cambridge's lists do not name any of them.

awarder, awarderQs: the awarding university's id in data/raw/institutions.json and its QS World University Rankings 2027 rank value there (a band at its lower bound); null when it is not there (Kean University is not in QS 2027). scripts/check-tiers.ts checks the two still agree.

marks: "uk" when graduates report UK-style percentage marks (70 a First, 60 a 2:1), as the University of Liverpool and the University of Nottingham mark; read with the UK bands, not the mainland percentage rule.
